events.verdict: Booker (PHX) gives Yabusele (PHI) a step of distance to avoid the contact, which Booker does not deliver during the back screen.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) initiates illegal contact across Durant's (PHX) left arm in order to get to the ball.
Yabusele (PHI) establishes a screening position in Beal's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact as he sets the pick.
Beal (PHX) steps to align alongside George's (PHI) path and the body contact is marginal.
After fumbling the ball, Oubre Jr. (PHI) initiates more-than-marginal contact to Allen (PHX).
Yabusele (PHI) is firming up over his left foot and does not deliver contact as he sets the pick on Booker (PHX).
Martin's (PHI) left heel is raised off of the floor and he does not step out of bounds upon receiving the pass.
Durant (PHX) keeps his hand on the side of the ball prior to making his cross-over dribble.
Yabusele (PHI) establishes a screening position in Beal's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact as he sets the pick.
Nurkic (PHX) jumps forward and turns into Maxey (PHI), initiating body contact that affects the floater attempt.
George (PHI) jumps forward to pursue the rebound and marginal arm/body contact occurs as Beal (PHX) secures it.
Nurkic's (PHX) hands come forward as he sets the pick on Martin (PHI) and marginal contact occurs simultaneously with the defensive switch.
Allen (PHX) follows through normally after tapping the loose ball and the contact with Lowry's (PHI) head is marginal.
Yabusele (PHI) and George (PHI) both legally contest Durant's (PHX) driving shot attempt.
George (PHI) places his off-arm against Allen (PHX) and releases from the contact as he steps back.
Allen (PHX) legally contests George's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
